constraints.name: hotel_accommodation_type_changes_previous_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((previous_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['HOTEL'::character varying, 'VILLA'::character varying, 'APARTMENT'::character varying, 'GUEST_HOUSE'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: hotel_accommodation_type_changes_requested_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((requested_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['HOTEL'::character varying, 'VILLA'::character varying, 'APARTMENT'::character varying, 'GUEST_HOUSE'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: hotel_accommodation_type_changes_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'APPROVED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: hotel_accommodation_type_changes_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL) AND (reviewer_id IS NULL) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (rejection_reason IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'REJECTED'::text) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (rejection_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM rejection_reason)) > 0))))

constraints.name: hotels_accommodation_type_allowed
constraints.definition: CHECK (((accommodation_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['HOTEL'::character varying, 'VILLA'::character varying, 'APARTMENT'::character varying, 'GUEST_HOUSE'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: hotels_approved_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((approved_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'PENDING'::character varying, 'APPROVED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: amenity_mapping_requests_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('PENDING'::character varying)::text, ('APPROVED'::character varying)::text, ('REJECTED'::character varying)::text, ('SUPERSEDED'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: room_inventory_review_requests_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('PENDING'::character varying)::text, ('APPROVED'::character varying)::text, ('REJECTED'::character varying)::text, ('SUPERSEDED'::character varying)::text])))
